def count_Substrings(s: str) -> int:
    prefix_sum = 0
    prefix_count = {0: 1}  # prefix sum 0 occurs once before any element
    count = 0
    
    for ch in s:
        # Subtract 1 from each digit so condition becomes sum == 0
        prefix_sum += int(ch) - 1
        
        # If this prefix sum has been seen before, there are substrings ending here
        count += prefix_count.get(prefix_sum, 0)
        
        # Record this prefix sum occurrence
        prefix_count[prefix_sum] = prefix_count.get(prefix_sum, 0) + 1
    
    return count
